AG811

Efficiency Expert.

The DJI Agras T70P agricultural drone is newly upgraded to support spraying, spreading, and lifting in various operational scenarios, with a maximum payload capacity of 70 kg[1]. It delivers enhanced efficiency while featuring Safety System 3.0[2] and advanced algorithms for comprehensive, round-the-clock[3] protection.

70 L Spraying Tank[1], 40 L/min Flow Rate

20 m/s Max Operation Speed[6]

100 L Spreading Tank[1], 400 kg/min Flow Rate[4]

65 kg Lifting[5]

Obstacle Avoidance
AR Enhanced Display

Ultra-Fast Charging

Spraying System
